supports.excerpt:
On your turn, there are 2 things you always do. Firstly, you take 1 tile from the display and secondly, you perform 1 action with one of your Action cards. You then have other options available to you. At the end there is some administration to take care of. Proceed in the following order: 
! ALWAYS 
1. Take 1 tile within range from the display. Your Action cards stay where they are. 
2. Perform 1 action with 1 of your Action cards. Move the used Action card all the way to the left. 
? POSSIBLY
3. Play 1 Building
4. Support 1 Conservation objective. 
5. Upgrade one or more of your Action cards. 
ADMINISTRATION 
6. At the end of your turn: • Keep to the tile limit • Replenish the display • Check whether the game ends 
The individual steps are explained in detail below. The illustrations at the bottom of your Zoo map are there to help you remember the sequence of the individual steps: 
1. ALWAYS: Take 1 Tile within range from the display
Take 1 tile from the display into your hand; the white arrow of your Projects Action card points at the maximum position from which you may take the tile. So, if the white arrow points to the value 1, only the tile in position 1 is within range for you, and you must take that tile. If the arrow points to the value 4, for example, you choose 1 tile from positions 1 to 4. IMPORTANT: This step does not move your Projects Action card! IMPORTANT: The "within range" restriction only applies in this step. If a tile effect or placement bonus allows you to take a tile from the display, you can always take a tile from any position of the display. EXAMPLE: The white arrow points to the "2'; which means the tile you take from the display into your hand can be in position 1 or 2. In this example, that would be either the Alpine Ibex in position 1 or the Indian Python in position 2. Your Projects Action card remains in its slot. Then you perform 1 of your 4 actions (see step (2)) 
2. ALWAYS: Perform 1 action with 1 of your Action cards 
Choose 1 of your Action cards and pull it a bit downward in its slot. Then perform 1 of the two actions listed on it with their current strength, EITHER to gain tiles OR to play tiles. 
Gaining tiles 
PROJECTS ACTION CARD Select 1 tile from the display (or 2 tiles if on Side II) Take any 1 tile from the display. The position of the tile on the display doesn't matter. If you have already upgraded the Projects action card, you may take a 2nd tile from the display. 
ANIMALS ACTION CARDS Draw 2 tiles from the pile 
Take the 2 topmost (face-down) tiles from the pile and put them in your hand. p.4
Playing Tiles (Animals or Projects) 
PROJECTS ACTION CARD Play 1 Project. 
If you have a Project in your hand and the strength of your Projects action is at least as high as the level of the tile, place the tile on your Zoo map (on an empty space next to either another tile or your zoo entrance). If it is a Release into the wild Project, place the tile on top of an Animal with the matching icon instead. The Animal (and its icons and points) are then covered and no longer count as being "in your zoo''. If placing the tile triggers effects (one-time effects, ongoing effects, or placement bonuses on the Zoo map), you may perform them in any order. 
ANIMALS ACTION CARDS Play 1 Animal (or 2 Animals if on Side II) 
You have 3 different Action cards to play Animals (yellow tiles). Each of these Action cards applies to a specific habitat (Rock, Forest, or Water). You can only play an Animal with the Action card that has the same habitat as the Animal. An exception to that are Animals with the "undefined" habitat, indicated by this icon: [undefined icon]. You can play such an Animal with any of the 3 Animals Action cards. To play an Animal from your hand, the strength of the matching action must be at least as high as the level of the Animal tile. Then place the Animal tile on your Zoo map (on an empty space next to either another tile or your zoo entrance). If the Animal requires one or more Open Areas, place it adjacent to existing Open Areas and/or place additional tiles from your hand face down as Open Areas on your Zoo map. If placing an Animal tile and/or Open Area triggers effects (one-time effects, ongoing effects, or placement bonuses on the Zoo map), you may perform them in any order. If you use this action to place an Animal next to an Animal with the same name (i.e. the female Animal next to the male Animal or vice versa, you immediately receive 1 Conservation marker. You may only play 1 Animal per action with side I of the Action card. If you have already upgraded the Action card, you may play 2 Animals (instead of just 1) from the corresponding habitat and/or with a [undefined icon]. However, the strength of the action must be at least as high as the sum of the levels of both Animals to do that. Play and place these Animals in your zoo one after the other. 
IMPORTANT: Always carry out all effects that you trigger by playing the first Animal before you play the second Animal. 
EXAMPLE - PLAYING A PROJECT: Since the Herpetologist is a level-4 Project, you must perform a Projects action with strength 4 or more to play it into your zoo. You place the Herpetologist on an empty space adjacent to the entrance. The Herpetologist has an ongoing effect that is triggered whenever you play a reptile icon into your zoo. Because the Herpetologist itself has a reptile icon, you immediately trigger its effect for the first time and take any 1 tile from the display into your hand. 
EXAMPLE - PLAYING 1 ANIMAL TILE: On your next turn, you play the female Nile Crocodile into your zoo. To do this, you need a Water Animals action with strength 4 or more, since the Nile Crocodile is an Animal with a Water icon (A) and is level 4 (B). The Nile Crocodile needs an Open Area in your zoo. To create one, you play another tile from your hand face down as an Open Area where the Nile Crocodile needs it (C). After you have placed both tiles, the effects of the Nile Crocodile and the Herpetologist are triggered. You receive 2 effects for playing the Nile Crocodile: the one-time effect of the Nile Crocodile (D) and the ongoing effect of the Herpetologist (E). If you receive multiple effects at the same time, you can always choose in which order you want to perform them. In this case, both effects let you draw any 1 tile from the display, so you may draw 2 tiles in total. p.5 
EXAMPLE -PLAYING 2 ANIMAL TILES: You want to use one of your upgraded Action cards to play 2 Animals into your zoo. The Capybara and the Goat are both level 2 (A), so you need an action with strength 4 or more to be able to play both Animals. The Goat's habitat is "undefined" (B), so you could play it with any of the 3 Animals actions, but the Capybara is a Water animal (C). You can therefore only play these two Animals together with the Water Animals action (D). Conveniently, this action currently has a strength of 4. You first play the male Capybara next to the female Capybara already in your zoo. Since you have managed to place a pair of animals of the same species directly next to each other (E), you receive 1 Conservation marker. Then you play the Goat next to the Alpaca already in your zoo. 
IMPORTANT: The only things you can place using Action cards are Animals and Projects, not Buildings! 
Complete the action 
After you have performed the action, remove the corresponding Action card from its slot. Move the Action cards left of the new gap rightward to close the gap. Finally, place the used Action card in the empty leftmost slot. If you use the leftmost Action card, you do not move any tiles. 
EXAMPLE: After you have performed the Projects action with strength 3, place the Projects Action card all the way on the left and move the Action cards in between 1 slot to the right. This increases the strength of the Rock animals and Forest animals actions by 1, i.e. to 2 and 3, respectively. The Projects action only has a strength of 1 on your next turn. The Water Animals action does not move, and keeps its strength of 4.
3 POSSIBLY: Play 1 Building If you have at least 1 Building (blue tile) in your hand for which you meet or can meet the playing condition, you may play exactly 1 such tile in this step. Place it on an empty space on your Zoo map (adjacent to either another tile or your zoo entrance) which meets the playing condition on the tile, if applicable. If placing the tile triggers effects (one-time effects, ongoing effects, or placement bonuses on the Zoo map), you may perform them in any order. 
EXAMPLE: The Tree House must be placed next to 2 tiles with a Forest icon (A). You play it on an empty space between the Dusky Leaf Monkey and the Great Horn bill, each of which has a Forest icon on their tile (B). Because the empty space shows the [display tile] icon as a placement bonus (C), you may take any 1 tile from the display.

IMPORTANT: Always carry out all effects that you trigger by playing the first Animal before you play the second Animal. 
EXAMPLE - PLAYING A PROJECT: Since the Herpetologist is a level-4 Project, you must perform a Projects action with strength 4 or more to play it into your zoo. You place the Herpetologist on an empty space adjacent to the entrance. The Herpetologist has an ongoing effect that is triggered whenever you play a reptile icon into your zoo. Because the Herpetologist itself has a reptile icon, you immediately trigger its effect for the first time and take any 1 tile from the display into your hand. 
EXAMPLE - PLAYING 1 ANIMAL TILE: On your next turn, you play the female Nile Crocodile into your zoo. To do this, you need a Water Animals action with strength 4 or more, since the Nile Crocodile is an Animal with a Water icon (A) and is level 4 (B). The Nile Crocodile needs an Open Area in your zoo. To create one, you play another tile from your hand face down as an Open Area where the Nile Crocodile needs it (C). After you have placed both tiles, the effects of the Nile Crocodile and the Herpetologist are triggered. You receive 2 effects for playing the Nile Crocodile: the one-time effect of the Nile Crocodile (D) and the ongoing effect of the Herpetologist (E). If you receive multiple effects at the same time, you can always choose in which order you want to perform them. In this case, both effects let you draw any 1 tile from the display, so you may draw 2 tiles in total. p.5 
EXAMPLE -PLAYING 2 ANIMAL TILES: You want to use one of your upgraded Action cards to play 2 Animals into your zoo. The Capybara and the Goat are both level 2 (A), so you need an action with strength 4 or more to be able to play both Animals. The Goat's habitat is "undefined" (B), so you could play it with any of the 3 Animals actions, but the Capybara is a Water animal (C). You can therefore only play these two Animals together with the Water Animals action (D). Conveniently, this action currently has a strength of 4. You first play the male Capybara next to the female Capybara already in your zoo. Since you have managed to place a pair of animals of the same species directly next to each other (E), you receive 1 Conservation marker. Then you play the Goat next to the Alpaca already in your zoo. 
IMPORTANT: The only things you can place using Action cards are Animals and Projects, not Buildings! 
Complete the action 
After you have performed the action, remove the corresponding Action card from its slot. Move the Action cards left of the new gap rightward to close the gap. Finally, place the used Action card in the empty leftmost slot. If you use the leftmost Action card, you do not move any tiles. 
EXAMPLE: After you have performed the Projects action with strength 3, place the Projects Action card all the way on the left and move the Action cards in between 1 slot to the right. This increases the strength of the Rock animals and Forest animals actions by 1, i.e. to 2 and 3, respectively. The Projects action only has a strength of 1 on your next turn. The Water Animals action does not move, and keeps its strength of 4.
3 POSSIBLY: Play 1 Building If you have at least 1 Building (blue tile) in your hand for which you meet or can meet the playing condition, you may play exactly 1 such tile in this step. Place it on an empty space on your Zoo map (adjacent to either another tile or your zoo entrance) which meets the playing condition on the tile, if applicable. If placing the tile triggers effects (one-time effects, ongoing effects, or placement bonuses on the Zoo map), you may perform them in any order. 
EXAMPLE: The Tree House must be placed next to 2 tiles with a Forest icon (A). You play it on an empty space between the Dusky Leaf Monkey and the Great Horn bill, each of which has a Forest icon on their tile (B). Because the empty space shows the [display tile] icon as a placement bonus (C), you may take any 1 tile from the display.

skill_drafts.name: 回合行动顺序执行流程
skill_drafts.description: 按规则规定的固定顺序引导玩家完整执行一个回合：先完成必做的取牌与行动卡行动，再处理可选的建造、支持保护目标与升级行动卡，最后进行回合结束管理。适用于玩家询问“这一回合该按什么顺序做什么”或不确定哪些步骤必做、哪些可选时。
skill_drafts.objective: 确保玩家按规则规定的顺序完整执行一个回合，不漏步骤、不颠倒顺序。
applicable_signals: 玩家询问一回合的操作顺序
玩家不确定哪些步骤必做、哪些可选
玩家在回合中需要确认下一步该做什么
contraindications: 玩家只问单张卡牌或单个图标的效果
玩家询问游戏结束后的计分
intervention_moves: 先说明两个必做步骤，再说明可选步骤，最后说明回合结束管理
强调取牌步骤不移动行动卡，行动卡移动只发生在执行行动之后
提醒只有动物与项目可通过行动卡放置，建筑需在可选步骤单独打出
在触发多个效果时允许玩家自行决定结算顺序
workflow_steps: 必做：从展示区取 1 张在范围内的牌入手，范围由 Projects 行动卡白色箭头决定，此步骤不移动行动卡
必做：选择 1 张行动卡，按当前强度执行获得牌或打出牌之一
完成行动后将所用行动卡移到最左侧槽位，其余行动卡右移补位
可选：打出 1 张满足条件的建筑
可选：支持 1 个保护目标
可选：升级 1 张或多张行动卡
回合结束管理：遵守手牌上限、补充展示区、检查游戏是否结束
triggers: 玩家询问一回合的操作顺序
玩家不确定哪些步骤必做、哪些可选
玩家需要核对回合是否完整执行
constraints: 必须严格按 1→6 的顺序执行，不得颠倒必做与可选步骤
取牌步骤中“在范围内”的限制仅适用于该步骤
只有动物与项目可通过行动卡放置，建筑不能通过行动卡放置
同时触发多个效果时，由玩家自行选择结算顺序
cautions: 若玩家只关心单个卡牌或图标效果，不应套用整个回合流程
游戏结束后的计分不属于本流程范围
output_contract: 玩家按 1→6 顺序完成取牌、行动、可选步骤与回合结束管理，并确认每一步是否触发效果及结算顺序。

examples.input: 我这一回合该按什么顺序做什么？
examples.output: 先做两件必做的事：1）从展示区取 1 张在范围内的牌入手，这一步不移动行动卡；2）选 1 张行动卡，按当前强度执行获得牌或打出牌之一，完成后把这张行动卡移到最左侧。然后你可以选择：打出 1 张建筑、支持 1 个保护目标、升级行动卡。最后做回合结束管理：遵守手牌上限、补充展示区、检查游戏是否结束。
examples.notes: 覆盖必做与可选步骤的完整顺序

metadata.prompt:
当玩家需要执行或核对一个完整回合时，按以下顺序逐步引导：
1. 必做：从展示区取 1 张在范围内的牌入手（范围由 Projects 行动卡上的白色箭头决定；此步骤不移动行动卡）。
2. 必做：选择 1 张行动卡，按其当前强度执行其两个行动之一（获得牌或打出牌），完成后将该行动卡移到最左侧槽位，其余行动卡相应右移补位。
3. 可选：打出 1 张建筑（蓝色牌），需满足其放置条件。
4. 可选：支持 1 个保护目标。
5. 可选：升级 1 张或多张行动卡。
6. 回合结束管理：遵守手牌上限、补充展示区、检查游戏是否结束。
每一步完成后确认是否触发效果并允许玩家自行选择效果结算顺序；提醒玩家只有动物与项目可通过行动卡放置，建筑不能。

skill_drafts.name: 行动卡强度与滑轨结算
skill_drafts.description: 结算一次行动卡行动：按行动卡当前强度判定可取/可放的牌，行动完成后将用过的行动卡移到最左槽、其余卡右移一格，并据此更新各行动卡的新强度。用于玩家询问行动卡强度如何计算，或完成行动后不确定卡牌如何移动。
skill_drafts.objective: 正确结算一次行动卡行动并更新滑轨上的行动卡位置与强度。
applicable_signals: 玩家询问行动卡强度如何计算
玩家完成行动后不确定卡牌如何移动
玩家需要判断当前强度能否取牌或放牌
contraindications: 玩家询问建筑或保护目标的放置条件
问题涉及回合开始取牌或行政阶段的其他步骤
intervention_moves: 确认所选行动卡及其当前强度
按强度判定可取/可放的牌
执行行动并结算触发效果
将用过的行动卡移到最左槽并右移其余卡
报告各行动卡更新后的新强度
workflow_steps: 确认所选行动卡及其当前强度。
按强度判定该行动可取/可放的牌（强度须满足取牌或放牌条件）。
执行该行动并结算其触发效果。
将该行动卡从槽位移出，把其左侧的卡右移一格补位，再把用过的卡放入最左空槽；若用的是最左卡则不移动任何卡。
报告各行动卡更新后的新强度。
triggers: 玩家询问行动卡强度如何计算
玩家完成行动后不确定卡牌如何移动
需要确认某行动当前强度是否足以取牌或放牌
constraints: 强度判定以行动卡当前强度为准。
用过的行动卡必须移到最左槽，其余卡右移一格。
若使用的是最左卡，则不移动任何卡。
cautions: 仅处理行动卡强度判定与滑轨移动，不扩展到建筑或保护目标的放置条件。
output_contract: 用过的行动卡置于最左槽，其余卡右移一格，各行动卡新强度确定并已向玩家说明。

examples.input: 我用强度3的项目行动卡完成行动后，卡牌怎么移动？
examples.output: 把项目行动卡移到最左槽，原本在它左侧的卡右移一格补位；项目行动卡下回合强度变为1，被右移的卡强度相应提高。
examples.notes: 示例说明滑轨移动与强度更新。

metadata.prompt: 当玩家询问行动卡强度如何计算，或完成一次行动后不确定行动卡如何移动时，使用本技能。步骤：1) 确认所选行动卡及其当前强度；2) 按强度判定该行动可取/可放的牌（取牌或放牌须满足强度≥牌等级等条件）；3) 执行该行动并结算其触发效果；4) 将该行动卡从槽位移出，把其左侧的卡右移一格补位，再把用过的卡放入最左空槽；若用的是最左卡则不移动任何卡；5) 报告各行动卡更新后的新强度。仅处理行动卡强度判定与滑轨移动这一小序列，不涉及建筑或保护目标的放置条件。

skill_drafts.name: 动物与项目放置合法性判定
skill_drafts.description: 判定单张动物或项目牌能否打出及放置位置是否合法：核对行动强度是否不低于牌等级、栖息地是否匹配（未定义栖息地可用任一动物行动）、放置位置是否相邻已有牌或入口、动物所需开放区是否相邻补齐。用于玩家询问“这张牌我现在能不能放、放哪里”。
skill_drafts.objective: 快速判定单张动物/项目牌的打出与放置是否合法。
applicable_signals: 玩家询问某张动物或项目牌能否打出
玩家不确定放置位置或开放区要求
contraindications: 玩家询问建筑牌（建筑不能用行动卡放置）
玩家询问触发效果的结算顺序
intervention_moves: 确认牌类型为动物或项目
核对行动强度不低于牌等级
核对栖息地匹配或未定义栖息地例外
核对放置位置相邻已有牌或入口
核对开放区相邻补齐要求
workflow_steps: 确认待判定牌为动物或项目牌；若为建筑牌则说明不能用行动卡放置。
核对所用行动卡强度是否不低于牌等级；动物需使用匹配栖息地的动物行动，未定义栖息地可用任一动物行动。
核对放置位置为空位且相邻已有牌或动物园入口。
若为动物且需要开放区，确认可在相邻位置补齐开放区。
若为放归野外项目，确认可覆盖匹配图标的动物。
汇总可否打出、需满足的条件及建议放置位置。
triggers: 玩家询问某张动物牌能否打出
玩家询问某张项目牌能否打出
玩家不确定放置位置是否合法
玩家不确定动物所需开放区如何补齐
constraints: 行动强度必须不低于牌等级
动物必须使用匹配栖息地的行动卡，未定义栖息地除外
放置位置必须相邻已有牌或入口
建筑不能用行动卡放置
cautions: 升级行动卡可一次打出两张动物时，强度需不低于两张牌等级之和
放归野外项目需覆盖匹配图标的动物，被覆盖动物不再计入动物园
output_contract: 给出该牌可否打出、需满足的强度/栖息地/位置条件及放置位置。

examples.output: 需要水栖动物行动强度至少为4，且放置位置相邻已有牌或入口；若需要开放区，需在相邻位置补齐开放区。
